worldcombat.skill.bounce.summary: The user compresses the ground, springs straight up to a short hang at the top, then drops along the locked landing point: enemies in the landing radius take a contact hit, are pressed down and pushed back, and may be left paralysed by the jolt. Target an enemy or a ground point; an aim point is projected onto the floor and kept inside this hop's reach, and an empty cast still springs and drops. The clear sky overhead at take-off decides how high it can go, so an open arena is the heaviest hit and a low roof turns it into a weak short hop.
worldcombat.skill.bounce.use.0: Leap over the melee fire and drop from above
worldcombat.skill.bounce.use.1: Land the paralysing jolt to break an opponent's rhythm
worldcombat.skill.bounce.use.2: Take a high landing spot before cover closes in
worldcombat.skill.bounce.use.3: Aim straight at the floor and drop on an empty spot
worldcombat.skill.bounce.description.0: The drop deals about %1$s contact damage to up to %2$s enemies inside the landing radius; the farther from the landing point, the lighter the hit, down to about six tenths at the rim. Those hit are also pressed down %3$s blocks and pushed back %4$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.bounce.description.1: It springs about %1$s blocks up, then drops along the landing point locked at take-off, about %2$s blocks away.
worldcombat.skill.bounce.description.2: It hangs at the top for %1$s, the landing radius is %2$s blocks, and a hit has a %3$s chance to paralyse the target for %4$s. While paralysed, movement speed is halved and every action attempt has a 25%% chance to fail.
worldcombat.skill.bounce.description.3: The clear sky overhead at take-off decides the real height: an open arena lets it go full and hit hardest, while a roof, cave or canopy forces a low hop under the ceiling and cuts the blow to little more than six tenths. Ground melee cannot reach it while it hangs, but ranged attacks can, and the target may walk away or tuck under cover that blocks the descent line. The visible 'Airborne' status sits on it while it hangs.
worldcombat.skill.bounce.crush.on: Crushing form: lower hop, shorter hang and a tighter landing point, traded for higher landing damage, a wider impact radius and a higher paralysis chance — good for slamming a target already on top of you.
worldcombat.skill.bounce.crush.off: Springy form: higher hop, longer hang and a farther landing point, good for taking a safe high spot before cover closes in.
worldcombat.skill.bounce.timing: Castable within %1$s blocks; after a %2$s wind-up it spends %4$s PP, recovers for %3$s, and goes on cooldown for %5$s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.bounce.growth.0: From level %1$s the landing power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.bounce.growth.1: From level %1$s it rises again to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.bounce.preference.crus: On (Crushing): lower hop, shorter hang and a tighter landing point, but landing power x1.18, radius x1.2 and paralysis chance x1.15, with a longer recovery and cooldown — good for slamming a target that is already on top of you. Off (Springy): a higher hop, a longer hang and a farther landing point, safer but lighter.
worldcombat.skill.bounce.preference.ai.m: The partner only considers bouncing while a threat is this close; smaller keeps it for near hits, larger lets it pounce from farther out.
worldcombat.skill.bounce.preference.ai.e: When the partner's health drops below this ratio it treats bounce as the leap that clears grounded melee, raising its priority; higher makes it hop away more often when being hit.
worldcombat.skill.bounce.preference.ai.l: When on, the partner will also leave its post to bounce out at an enemy.
